segments.text: A chance to reconnect, hear about everyone's day and share a meal.

segments.text: But when children refuse to eat the food that's been cooked, the result is often conflict rather than family fun.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: They definitely don't. We go through multiple periods of up and downs where their appetite is much lower and then all of a sudden it comes right back.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: a phrase meaning that a mixture of good and bad things happen to them Sometimes they eat everything happily other times they don It depends on many things including their day the weather and their mood A person mood is the way they feeling at a

segments.text: So, how can parents make dinner time something everyone enjoys? In this episode,

segments.speaker: Neil

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: B. Don't pressure your child to eat everything on the plate,

segments.text: That's quite hard. They all seem like quite good tips.

segments.text: Many parents say dinnertime can become a battleground So why is it that what you eating can trigger so much tension I think for small children it one of the few areas that they have control over I mean

segments.text: parents can cook what they want and serve it when they want, but it's up to kids to decide
